decisive_findings: The ratified derivation carried a STRICTER vocabulary than the commission's minimum: a 10-value exact decision precedence and a 7-value public state map. Both were implemented verbatim rather than replaced by the commission's shorter enumeration.

The derivation illustrated INCOMPLETE coverage with a single example (UNDETERMINED_NO_POSITIVE_AUTHORITY). This implementation uses the general definition, any non-terminal decision, which is strictly safer because COMPLETE can never be reported while any candidate is undecided.

A real production defect was found and fixed during implementation: an incomplete request key surfaced as a Python constructor TypeError instead of the typed SERVICE_REQUEST_UNDETERMINED refusal the contract requires.
A second real production defect: admission_authority_ref was validated before coercion to AuthorityRef, raising AttributeError on the normal mapping input path.
Three court-authoring bugs were also caught and fixed, including a hygiene check that wrongly banned the literal POOLING even though naming a forbidden purpose IS the refusal mechanism.
No existing owner of service-source applicability exists on current control, so the OWNER_COLLISION disposition was not triggered.

Only ADMITTED carries any positive power flag; may_condition_F8, may_pool_respondents, may_transform_geometry_or_distribution, may_support_individual_inference, may_rank_or_select, may_grant_target_use_permission and may_authorise_backfill are False for EVERY state including ADMITTED.
limits_and_open_items: The owner is a source-free authority seam. No source universe, service, target or candidate class has been populated; this lane delivers the FORM, not occupancy.
Service-specific applicability authority must still be authored per service/source pair before any admissible set is non-empty in practice.
H-A temporal directionality, H-D F8 geometry transformation, and the H-C sibling questions HQ already adjudicated elsewhere remain open and are untouched by this lane.
candidate_class coverage will be INCOMPLETE for any real class until per-source applicability authority exists, which is the correct and intended fail-closed posture.
self_adoption_statement: This lane implements the HQ-ratified form and returns it for independent review. It does not adopt the authority, populate any class, issue any warrant, or authorize any live or raw-source execution.
